title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Airport Capacity Enhancement Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will improve airport capacity at Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) in Kathmandu and at Gautam Buddha Airport (GBA) in Lumbini by constructing a parallel taxiway extension and domestic apron areas at TIA and a new international terminal building at GBA.
